name: Matrix Scroller - All Panels State
description: Turn the matrix scroller on or off for every panel at once (the Enable Output switch). Each panel keeps its own on/off setting, so turning all panels back on restores them as they were.

args.name: State
args.help: On enables all panels, Off disables all panels and clears the matrices, Toggle switches to the opposite of the current state.

name: Matrix Scroller - Panel State
description: Turn one panel on or off and save it (the panel's Enabled checkbox). Other panels are not affected. A panel that is on still shows nothing while All Panels State is Off.

args.name: Panel
args.help: The panel to change, as named on the Matrix Scroller page.

args.name: State
args.help: On enables the panel, Off disables it and clears its matrix, Toggle switches it to the opposite of its current state.

name: Matrix Scroller - Show Message
description: Scroll your own text on one panel or all panels instead of the song information.

args.name: Message
args.help: The text to scroll, e.g. Show starts at 6 PM.

args.name: Duration
args.help: How long to show the message before going back to normal. 0 keeps it until Clear Message is run.

name: Matrix Scroller - Clear Message
description: Remove a message set by Show Message, returning the panel to song or idle display.

name: Matrix Scroller - Restore Snapshot
description: Replace the scroller's whole configuration with a snapshot saved on the Matrix Scroller page, e.g. to switch looks between show phases.

args.name: Snapshot
args.help: A snapshot saved with Save Snapshot on the Matrix Scroller page.
